newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly higher vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly higher vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 50 centavos higher against the dollar at 1,078.50 in active trading on the country's jittery interbank market.

Dealers said the peso trended lower throughout most of the session on dollar-buying spurred by expectations of a cut in domestic interest rates when the central bank's policy-making board of directors meets late Tuesday.
But the local currency cut its losses in late-session trading on dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters.
Dealers reported an above-average total of 555 trades for $245 million and said the peso held in a 1,076.40-to-1,083.50 range.
